items.title: Judge's question for the GM: in Durgan's Situational tab
items.do: As the GM, the Orc Warrior attacks Aveline next to Durgan (Judged Orc); when Judge's question comes, click the empty map, then Durgan's token; deselect him and select him again; answer it there.
items.expect: Each time Durgan is selected, his HUD opens on the Situational tab with the question in it (Not now / Reduce by N), not an empty tab and not the large bar.
